correctness.rationale: Normalize nonzero real coefficients to norm one; sign changes and permutations allow 0<=b1<=...<=b5 after zero padding. For each subset J, the corresponding signed sum is s-2w(J), and the two-sided tail probability equals N/16, where N=#{J:w(J)<=(s-1)/2=τ}. Two exact polynomial identities verified symbolically show τ>=min(b3,b1+b2); the four minimal candidate subsets are therefore always admissible. Ordering candidate next weights {b3,b4,b1+b2} as u<=v<=w proves N=4 iff u<=τ<v, including ties and zero coordinates; otherwise at least five subsets qualify, hence tail >=5/16. The pairwise subset-weight comparison covers all other subsets, not just the displayed five. Direct independent exact arithmetic checks on 1286 nonzero nondecreasing integer tuples 0..8 confirmed all 32 sign counts and 261 equality cases, but the real-parameter theorem rests on the inequalities.
